newsitem.title: FRANCE: French minister worried by GIAT finances.
newsitem.headline: French minister worried by GIAT finances.

text.p: France's Finance Minister voiced concern to a parliamentary committee on Wednesday about the finances of state arms manufacturer GIAT Industries for 1998, according to minutes released after the closed hearing.

According to the minutes, Dominique Strauss-Kahn told the National Assembly defence committee that the state was due to inject funds into GIAT in coming weeks to help ease its cash-flow up to mid-1998.
"Despite this, it remains the case that new problems will come up after that date," he was quoted as saying.
GIAT Industries is mainly known for the Leclerc battle tank.
The company made an operational loss of 530 million francs in 1996 after a similar loss of 1.7 billion in 1995, when it also underwent a huge restructuring.
The minutes gave no details on the size of the latest state cash injection, or if it had been previously included in the company's restructuring plans.
